item.title: How does Gen Z feel about President Trump?
item.description: With a new war in the Middle East underway and midterm elections approaching, campaigns will be poring over fresh polling data trying to spot changes in the electorate.

item.title: Ghanaian-American disability advocate struts the catwalk for awareness
item.description: Abena Christine Jon'el took to the catwalk this winter at the latest annual Rhythms On Da Runway fashion show in Ghana, one of Africa's top fashion and music showcases.

item.title: Local Iranians hope the war brings change to their home country
item.description: For those Iranians in the U.S., there are an array of opinions on the war President Trump has brought to their home country. And there's no clear indication the Iranian people can replace the Islamic Republic with the kind of secular democracy many are calling for.

item.title: Federal judge rejects Sheriff Steven Tompkins' efforts to dismiss extortion charges
item.description: The ruling is a setback for the longtime Democrat, who pleaded not guilty last year to allegations that he pressured an executive for stock in a cannabis company before a public offering and then demanded his money back when the stock tanked.

item.title: Measles cases are on the rise. Here’s what Mass. residents need to know
item.description: In late February, officials identified two measles cases in Massachusetts residents, as outbreaks grow around the country. Here’s what to know about the resurgence of measles.

item.title: The Beech-Wood Box
item.description: Krassimira Belev (The Therapy) and acclaimed violinist Christian Hebel star in a Romani tale about how the very first violin came to be.

item.title: The Trump administration's war against legal immigration
item.description: The Trump administration is publicly cracking down on illegal immigration.Behind the scenes, the White House is also fighting a war against legal immigration. How the administration is working to grind immigration to a halt.

item.title: Fear and anxiety at Mass. health centers amid federal funding cuts
item.description: A change in federal grant rules has added new uncertainty about what services might trigger a grant cancellation notice. Employees don’t know what further precautions to take. Administrators are afraid to speak out.

item.title: DiZoglio spars with state lawmakers over public records reform
item.description: Massachusetts Auditor Diana DiZoglio and a group of state lawmakers broke into verbal brawls Tuesday during a hearing on a potential ballot question to expand the state's public records law to cover the Legislature and Governor’s Office.

item.title: Boston Fleet's Olympians get hero's welcome from fans
item.description: Four Boston-based Olympians received a hero's welcome Monday, as hundreds of fans crowded the top floor of the Prudential Center to see the ice hockey medalists.
